senses.gloss: Sea,Ⓒs.ⒹsAgaraH, samudraH, udaDiH, arRavaH, jala-DiH, vAriDiH, apAMpatiH; See Ocean; ‘a rough s(ea)’ kzubDArRavaH; ‘s(ea) of worldly existence’ BavasAgaraH, saMsArArRavaH; ‘s(ea) of troubles’ kleSasAgaraH, duHKArRavaH, &c.; ‘go to s(ea)’ nAvikaH-sAMyAtrikaH-BU 1 P, nAvikavfttiM sev 1 A; ‘beyond the s(eas)s’ dvIpAMtaraM-re; ‘s(ea)-beat’ taraMgAhata; ‘s(ea)-faring’ samudraga-yAyin, sAMyAtrika; ‘s(ea)-fight’ nOyudDaM; ‘s(ea)-girt’ See Girt; ‘s(ea)-green’ SyAmaharita, sAgaravarRa; ‘s(ea)-gull’ karaMdaH; ‘s(ea) man’ nAvikaH, samudragaH, potavAhaH; ‘s(ea)-port’ potASrayasTAnaM, potaSaraRaM, nOkASrayaH; n.; ‘s(ea)-shore’ samudratawaM-tIraM, velA, roDas n.; ‘s(ea) sick’ samudracCardizmat; ‘s(ea)-side’ samudra-velA &c.

Seal,Ⓒs.ⒹmudrA, (fig. also); ‘opening the s(eal) of sleep’ kzipannidrAmudrAM (Mal. 2); ‘open it, preserving the s(eal) and show me’ mudrAM paripAlayan udGAwya darSaya (Mu. 5); ‘s(eal) of the lips’ ozWamudrA.
Ⓑ
 2 makaraH, nakraH.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓmudrayati (D.).
Ⓑ
 2 nirRI 1 P, sTirIkf 8 U, dfQIkf, dfQayati (D.); ‘the defeat in that battle s(eal)ed his fate’ parAjayena tasya BAvigatiH ekAMtataH nirRItA.
Ⓑ
 2 mudrayA aMk 10; or cihnayati (D.).
Ⓑ
 3 (mudrayA) pi-DA 3 U, baMD 9 P; muKaM baDnAti ‘s(eal) as the lips’.
Ⓝ[Seal]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓmudrita, kftamudra, mudrAMkita, mudrAbadDa; ‘s(eal)ing wax’ lA(rA)kzA; See Lac.

Zeal,Ⓒs.ⒹutsAhaH, OtsukyaM, sotsAhatA, vyagratA, AsTA, atyutkaMWA, udyogaH, uttApaH, uccaMqatA, atyanurAgaH.
Ⓝ[Zeal]ous,Ⓒa.ⒹsotsAha, ati-, utsuka, utsAhavat, vyagra, caMqa, tIkzRa, atyAsakta, udyukta, tIkzRakarman
Ⓝ[Zeal]ously,Ⓒadv.ⒹOtsukyena, sotsAhaM, vyagratayA.
ⓃZealot,Ⓒs.ⒹativyagraH, sotsAhaH.

Seam,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMDiH; sIvanaM; ‘s(eam) of planks’ kAzWasaMDiH.
Ⓑ
 2 SuzkavraRaH.
Ⓝ[Seam]y,Ⓒa.ⒹsaMDiyukta; ‘turn the s(eamy) side within’ svadozAn pracCAdaya-nigUha.
ⓃSeamstress,Ⓒs.ⒹsUcikA, sUcikarmopajIvinI.

Sear,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓnirdah 1 P, pluz 1 P, dahanena dfQIkf or SuzkIkf 8 U.
Ⓔa.ⒹsaMSuzka, viSIrRa, mlAna.

Search,Ⓒv.Ⓓ(For) anviz 4 P, nirUp 10, anusaMDA 3 U, mfg 10 A, mArg 1 P, 10, vici 5 U, nir-ava-Ikz 1 A; (fig.) ni-puRaM parIkz or nirUp; ‘s(earch) into’ nirUp, parIkz; ‘s(earch) out’ anvizya &c. upalaB 1 A or prAp 5 P.
Ⓝ⒈ [Search]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹanvezaRaM-RA, mArgaRaM, nirUpaRaM, anusaMDAnaM, nirIkzaRaM, anvIkzaRaM; vicayaH, jijYAsA.
Ⓝ[Search]er,Ⓒs.ⒹanvezakaH, anvezwf m., nirUpakaH, nirIkzakaH; ‘s(earcher) of the human heart’ puruzAMtaravid.
Ⓝ⒉ [Search]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹnipuRa, sUkzma, avahita; ‘casting at me a s(earching) look’ sunipuRaM mAM vilokya.

Season,Ⓒs.ⒹftuH, kAlaH, samayaH; (in general) kAlaH, velA, samayaH, avasaraH, avakASaH, prastAvaH; ‘auspicious s(eason)’ lagnaM, muhUrtaH, SuBa-velA-lagnaM; ‘in due s(eason)’ kAle; ‘pertaining to the s(eason)’ Artava (vI f.); ‘out of s(eason)’ akAle, anavakASe; ‘in s(eason) and out of s(eason)’ kAlo'kAlo vA, OcityAnOcityamavi-cArya; ‘wrong s(eason)’ akAlaH, anavakASaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹaDi-, vAs 10, upaskf 8 U or svA-dUkf.
Ⓑ
 2 pac 1 P, paripAkaM utpad c., pakvIkf; See Mature.
Ⓑ
 3 (Accustom) ex. by paricaya, sahizRu, &c.; ‘s(eason)ed to heat’ ravikiraRasahizRu (S. 2); ‘s(eason)s the body to exertions’ SramajayAt tanuM praguRAM karoti (R. ix. 49); ‘s(eason)ed to exertions’ ji-taSrama, SramasahizRu.
Ⓝ[Season]able,Ⓒa.Ⓓsamayocita, kAlAnurUpa, prastAvasadfSa (SI f.), prAptakAla, kAlocita, and sim. comp.
Ⓑ
 2 kAlakfta, kAla in comp.; ‘s(easonable) efforts’ kAlakftodyogAH.
Ⓑ
 3 Artava (vI f.), kAlo-dBava, ftuja, ftavya.
Ⓝ[Season]ableness,Ⓒs.ⒹkAlO-cityaM, prastAvasAdfSyaM, &c.
Ⓝ[Season]ably,Ⓒadv.ⒹyaTAkAlaM-samayaM-avasaraM, kAle, samaye, prastAva-sadfSaM, prAptakAlaM, kAlAnurUpaM.
Ⓝ[Season]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹupaskaraH, vyaMjanaM.

Seat,Ⓒs.ⒹAsanaM, pIWaH-WaM; ‘take a s(eat) here’ atra AsanaparigrahaM karotu BavAn; paryaMkaH (‘s(eat) on a sofa’), vizwaraH (‘cane-s(eat)’); AstaraH-raRaM; ‘raised s(eat)’ vitardi-rdI f., vedikA.
Ⓑ
 2 zWAnaM, AyatanaM, AspadaM, DAman n., aDi-zWAnaM, niketanaM, ni-A-layaH, AgAraM, padaM, ASayaH; ‘capital s(eat)’ rAjaDAnI-nagaraM; ‘s(eat) of justice’ nyAyAsanaM, DarmAsanaM, vyavahArAsanaM; ‘s(eat) of blood’ raktASayaH; kroDasTAnaM; vi-dyAgAraM, &c.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓ(Oneself) Asane upaviS 6 P, nizad 1 P, AsanaparigrahaM kf 8 U; (another) (Asane) c., upaviS c., AsanaM grah c., aDyAs c., aDi-zWA c., (-zWApayati).
Ⓑ
 2 pratizWA c., aDikf, aDi-A-ruh c., niviS c.; ‘he was s(eat)ed on throne’ rAjapadamaDiropitaH, siMhAsanepratizWApitaH.
Ⓝ[Seat]ed,Ⓒa.ⒹAsIna, upavizwa, nizaRRa, aDyAsIna; AsanasTa, AsanasTita-upavizwa-ArUQa-gata-ASrita, pIWasTa; ‘s(eated) at ease’ suKAsIna, suKopavizwa; ‘be s(eated)’ gfhyatAM AsanaM, kriyatAmAsanaparigrahaH.
Ⓑ
 2 pratizWita, nivizwa, sTita, gata-sTa-nizWa in comp.; ‘s(eated) in the heart’ [] hfdayanizWa, hftsTa; kaMWagata, asTinizWa, &c.
